meeting_point: Dry Creek Wine Region: Healdsburg, CA
description:
#Come savor the wines of the Dry Creek Valley!

##Rates
 • **Adult** $209 *Ages 16 and up*
 • **Child/Teen** $160 *Ages <15*

##Time
 **10:00AM - 3:30PM**

##About
Imagine going to Provence without leaving the country... Sun kissed vines, olive trees, and the golden hills. We cycle along the newly paved quiet back roads, to family owned wineries, one mile at a time… 

**Arguably the best bicycling day trip anywhere in the country.** A fantastic, quiet road where every turn brings a picture postcard view. Come cycle with us Getaway Style. No one matches our routes, bikes and most importantly our guides. Discover the beauty and tranquility of these fabled wine regions. Our award winning guides will take you to all the best places, prepare a tasty picnic spread, and take you into the vineyards for our “grapes 101”.
We travel 10 to 12 miles, visit 2 wineries, and have our picnic lunch at one of our favorites. Rated easy and mostly flat. Suitable for all abilities. Includes use of e-bike and helmet, all gear, van support, unlimited bottled spring water and bars. Professional guide(s), free wine pickup. Wine country picnic lunch also included.


##Meeting Location
• **Getaway Adventures/Wine Country Bikes, 359 Hudson St, Healdsburg, 95448**


##Includes
 • **Use of Electric bike and helmet, unlimited water, Wine Country picnic lunch, and professional local guides.**


##Wineries we may visit
 • **Quivira, Martorana, Mauritson, Bella, Comstock, Truett Hurst, Mill Creek, Kokomo, Dry Creek and many others**
